name: Toolkit
insp: playful product launch sites and bento-grid app pages
desc: Built for small business owners. Seven service tiles spring out of an isometric pile into a bento grid of raised, embossed blocks that press in when tapped. Three questions make the right tiles jump to the front and fill in the enquiry, and the tax dates flip down like keys.
fx: Service tiles spring from an isometric pile into the grid as you scroll
Headline letters spring in one by one
Tiles, buttons and answer keys are raised embossed blocks that press in when you tap them, with debossed icons and numbers
Three questions make the suggested tiles jump to the front with a green ring
The five promises slide past in a pinned sideways row, on phones and tablets too
On phones each tile springs out of a diamond and rises out of the page, headings rise line by line and the tax date keys flip down and press in
